name: Star no Koibito
source:
I'm going to be a ghost writer for the popular idol KIITO! College life has changed completely by attending a party in the entertainment world. I'm a star lover!?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220825150605/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.starkoi]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
我竟然要给当红偶像KIITO当代笔作家！自从参加了一场演艺圈派对，我的大学生活便发生了翻天覆地的变化。我成了明星的恋人！？

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220825150605/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.starkoi]Google Play[/url]]
